final_wiki.answer-Q-5438-Z5L:
The largest prime number less than 1840 is 1831.

To verify:
- 1839 = 3 × 613 (not prime)
- 1838 is even (not prime)
- 1837 = 11 × 167 (not prime)
- 1836 is even (not prime)
- 1835 ends in 5 (not prime)
- 1834 is even (not prime)
- 1833 divisible by 3 (not prime)
- 1832 is even (not prime)
- 1831 is prime (not divisible by any prime up to √1831 ≈ 42.8)

Answer: 1831
